title: Agentic AI in Healthcare & Medicine: A Seven-Dimensional Taxonomy for Empirical Evaluation of LLM-based Agents
reasoning: The paper explicitly includes 'Safety & Ethics' as one of its seven core dimensions for evaluating LLM agents. It systematically analyzes and maps 49 studies based on sub-dimensions such as 'Safety Guardrails & Adversarial Robustness', 'Bias & Fairness', 'Privacy-Preserving Mechanism', and 'Regulatory & Compliance Constraints', making ethical evaluation a central component of the survey.
